lede: South Florida carries the stronger underlying team rating — +0.7 against -6.1, a 6.8-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Army +2.1 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with South Florida winning 55% of simulations.

Data confidence on this matchup is 41% — enough to publish, not enough to treat the exact margin as settled.
